minutes.headline: Board set a Nov. 28 special town meeting, gave warnings in liquor hearings, and suspended JM Sports Bar
minutes.summary: The Select Board heard a solar developer's pilot-payment proposal and put it off to Oct. 17. It held liquor license hearings on underage-sale violations and gave warnings to most licensees. It suspended one bar whose owner did not appear. It also set a special town meeting, declined to sign a letter backing a Lancaster water grant, and planned upcoming workshops.

what_happened.line: The Select Board called a special town meeting for Nov. 28 at 7 pm and opened the warrant until Oct. 11 at 4 pm.
The board suspended the license of JM Sports Bar for three days, Nov. 3-5, after an underage-sale hearing.
The board deferred a solar developer's payment-in-lieu-of-taxes proposal to Oct. 17, to return with final numbers.
Most other licensees at the liquor hearings received warnings, including a finding of violation for Elena's Gourmet Grocery.
The board voted not to sign a letter endorsing Lancaster's MassWorks grant application at this time.

why_it_matters: The solar payment-in-lieu-of-taxes terms set how much property tax revenue the town gets from the project each year, so the Oct. 17 numbers will shape that income.
The special town meeting is a vote residents can attend, and its warrant, still open at this meeting, lists the items they will be asked to decide.
watch_next: Oct. 17 Select Board meeting: the solar payment proposal returns with final numbers.
Nov. 28 special town meeting at 7 pm; the warrant closes Oct. 11 at 4 pm.
